# Tadas

> A multi-tenant to-do application for teams of people and the agents that work alongside them, and the reference implementation of the Software Design and Architecture Guidelines: one object model at the center, one infrastructure toolkit, an API process and a maintenance worker around them, and a portal, a command line, and a TypeScript and a Python client at the edge.

This file is the knowledge map. Each section lists the documents one
audience is served; a document not listed under an audience is not
served to it. Exposure is by listing, never by folder.

## Platform developers

- [README](README.md): what Tadas is, the quick start with the local URLs and sign-ins, set up and check, deploy and operate, and the layout
- [Architecture](specs/architecture.md): the guideline's pin, the substitutions, and the deviations, each linking its decision record
- [Decisions](docs/adr/): one file per decision
- [What Tadas is made of](om/README.md): the nouns and how they relate, for a reader with no code
- [Tenancy](om/src/tadas/om/tenancy/README.md): orgs, identities, users, memberships, sessions, API keys, socket tickets, the role ladder, sign-in and sign-out, invitations, single sign-on, the operator plane, and deletion
- [Tasks](om/src/tadas/om/tasks/README.md): the to-do items, their rank and version, the due date and its reminder, attachments, the import, and the archive
- [Orchestrations](om/src/tadas/om/orchestrations/README.md): long-running records that park on the plan or fail at a bound: the import and the daily cleanup
- [Files](om/src/tadas/om/media/README.md): files as references, the bounded upload straight to the store, and the sweep
- [Slack](om/src/tadas/om/slack/README.md): the app an org installs, its bot token, its channel, and the record of every post
- [Billing](om/src/tadas/om/billing/README.md): plans and their bounds, the org's account at the payment processor, deliveries applied once, and grants
- [Events](om/src/tadas/om/events/README.md): the org's stream, its gapless sequence above a floor, and audit entries
- [Work items](om/src/tadas/om/work/README.md): background jobs, the claim, the lease, and the dead letter
- [Idempotency records](om/src/tadas/om/idempotency/README.md): the outcome of a request that may arrive twice
- [Outbox rows](om/src/tadas/om/outbox/README.md): the note written beside every change, and its relay
- [Infrastructure](infra/README.md): cache, buckets, topics, queues, secrets, observability; what each promises and which twin runs where
- [Integrations](integrations/README.md): Slack, WorkOS, and Stripe, each an interface, a client, and a twin, and the deadline a request's calls share
- [The API process](services/api/README.md): the routes by area, the gateway's guarantees, the subcommands
- [The maintenance worker](workers/maintenance/README.md): the work queue's loop, the provider deliveries, the Slack posts, and the sweep
- [Deployment](deployment/README.md): what runs where, locally and in the cloud, and the branch convention
- [The local stack](deployment/local/README.md): every URL and port, one service at a time
- [Terraform](deployment/terraform/modules/README.md): the roots, the modules, the state, the credentials, and the portal's CDN
- [Cloud cost](deployment/cloud/README.md): the sizes, each environment's size, and the budgets
- [Operations](ops/README.md): roles, profiles, credentials, signals, the ops binary, the skills, the audits
- [Audit tools](ops/audit/README.md): what the audit skills run
- [Stress tests](ops/stress/README.md): what a good one is and the scenario file
- [Runbooks](docs/runbooks/README.md): one file per operational procedure
- [The portal](apps/portal/README.md): the browser app, which calls the API on its own origin
- [The company site](apps/site/README.md): the static page and where it is served
- [The command line](apps/cli/README.md): the terminal client and its exit codes
- [The TypeScript client](clients/typescript/README.md): the one client every browser app imports
- [The Python client](clients/python/README.md): the one client every Python caller goes through

## Platform operators

- [Operations](ops/README.md): roles, profiles, credentials, signals, the ops binary, the skills, the audits, what an operator never does
- [Audit tools](ops/audit/README.md): what the audit skills run
- [Stress tests](ops/stress/README.md): what a good one is and the scenario file
- [Runbooks](docs/runbooks/README.md): one file per operational procedure
- [Deploy runbook](docs/runbooks/deploy.md): cutting a release, approving a plan, rolling back
- [Operate runbook](docs/runbooks/operate.md): reading an environment under the investigate profile
- [Operator runbook](docs/runbooks/operator.md): the grant, the second factor, and the operator token
- [Scale runbook](docs/runbooks/scale.md): the one variable that turns autoscaling on
- [Restore runbook](docs/runbooks/restore.md): what is backed up, and a restore to a new instance
- [Stripe runbook](docs/runbooks/providers/stripe.md): the payment processor: its accounts, keys, bootstrap, webhook secret, local deliveries, rotation, and what breaks
- [WorkOS runbook](docs/runbooks/providers/workos.md): the sign-in provider: its environments, the application and its key, the redirects, the bootstrap, rotation, and what breaks
- [Slack runbook](docs/runbooks/providers/slack.md): the Slack app: one per environment, its secrets, the install, the twin, rotation, and what breaks
- [Support runbook](docs/runbooks/support.md): how a support investigation runs
- [Tenant isolation runbook](docs/runbooks/tenant-isolation.md): the cross-tenant cases and what they catch
- [Deployment](deployment/README.md): what runs where, locally and in the cloud, and the branch convention

## Tenant users and admins

- [What Tadas is made of](om/README.md): the nouns and how they relate, for a reader with no code
- [Tenancy](om/src/tadas/om/tenancy/README.md): your personal org and team orgs, people, roles, invitations, single sign-on, credentials, and deleting an org or your account
- [Tasks](om/src/tadas/om/tasks/README.md): the to-do items, their due dates, and their rules
- [Orchestrations](om/src/tadas/om/orchestrations/README.md): importing tasks from a file, and the archive of old done tasks
- [Files](om/src/tadas/om/media/README.md): the files kept with the work, their bounds, and the storage used
- [Slack](om/src/tadas/om/slack/README.md): adding Tadas to Slack, picking its channel, what it posts, and its commands
- [Billing](om/src/tadas/om/billing/README.md): the plans, what each allows, and how an org pays
- [Events](om/src/tadas/om/events/README.md): the org's diary
- [Work items](om/src/tadas/om/work/README.md): background jobs
- [Idempotency records](om/src/tadas/om/idempotency/README.md): why a repeated request does one thing
- [Outbox rows](om/src/tadas/om/outbox/README.md): why every change is announced
- [The command line](apps/cli/README.md): the terminal client and its exit codes
